verdict.rationale: The docs show a local dev setup is supported. Loki can be tried locally as a single binary with a local filesystem backend and Alloy as the log sender, and Mimir runs in monolithic mode with one binary and no added dependencies. Grafana itself ships as self-managed OSS, with file-based dashboard provisioning and a CLI described as suitable for local development, and a community user self-hosted Grafana with InfluxDB in a lab. Missing for 10: an explicit quickstart for running the Grafana server locally (e.g. Docker or binary install), local Tempo/trace setup guidance for testing instrumentation end to end, and independent hands-on reports of local dev workflows.
